clips.title: The story
paras: A Putrid Task is an early military assignment offered by Deathguard Dillinger in Brill. It directs adventurers to push back the mindlessly aggressive Scourge encroaching upon the old bridge west of the settlement. Collecting proof of the monsters' destruction secures the road and eases pressure on Tirisfal's defenders.

Brill sits at a critical crossroads in eastern Tirisfal Glades, making any enemy approach a direct threat to the Forsaken power base. Mindless Scourge constantly seep westward across the waterways, clustering around the broken remnants of the old stone bridge. Without regular patrols beating them back, the shambling corpses would quickly choke transit between Brill and the western farmsteads.

For the Forsaken, Scourge roaming their borders is not merely a strategic nuisance; it is an insult. Every mindless ghoul and rotting corpse represents the servitude and torment that Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's followers broke away from. Deathguards like Dillinger take grim satisfaction in crushing their former captors, demanding severed claws as brutal proof that the mindless dead have been put to rest for good.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Scourge have trickled into Tirisfal Glades and have infested the area west of Brill, near the old bridge.
Go there and beat back the rotting dead and ravaged corpses you find. Scatter their bones and bring back their putrid claws, and the Deathguards will reward you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you? Do you have those putrid claws?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done. I regret not being there to see you smash those undead into rotting pulp!
